agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MARCH 10, 2021 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Oath of Office for Appointed City Council Member District 3 Joy Lyndes
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the February 16, 2021 Special Joint City Council/Planning Commission Meeting, February 17, 2021 Regular Meeting, and the February 24, 2021 Special Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2021-03-10 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Assistant Director of Finance Gallup
Approve the Warrants.
2021-03-10 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
Second Reading of Ordinance 2021-01 establishing a new speed limit on Via Cantebria. Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Barr
Adopt Ordinance 2021-01 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) titled “An Ordinance of the City of Encinitas, California Establishing Speed Limit on Via Cantebria” establishing a new speed limit of 30 mph on Via Cantebria between Garden View Road and Town Center Drive.
2021-03-10 Item 08C Via Cantebria Ordinance Adoption
8D.
Urgency Ordinance capping restaurant delivery fees. Contact Person: Assistant City Manager Delin
Adopt Ordinance 2021-03 on an urgency basis entitled “An Urgency Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Establishing a Temporary Limit on the Charges Imposed by Third-Party Delivery Services on Retail Food Establishments During the Declared State of Emergency Resulting from the COVID-19 Pandemic.”
2021-03-10 Item 08D Restaurant Delivery Fee Caps - Urgency Ordinance
8E.
Award of Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) Systems Maintenance and Replacement Contract. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
City Council authorizes the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a contract in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report for HVAC systems maintenance and equipment replacement between the City of Encinitas and Countywide Mechanical Systems, Inc. (Countywide) for an amount not to exceed $622,179 if all options to extend are exercised.
2021-03-10 Item 08E Award of Mechanical Systems Maintenance Contract
8F.
Request for authorization to conduct a Proposition 218 public hearing to consider a new organics collection rate, franchise fee increase, and a temporary special fee, as well as a recommendation to approve a new public hearing schedule for solid waste fee adjustments. Contact Person: Management Analyst Stratakis
a) Adopt the new organics collection rate, effective June 1, 2021. b) Consider an increase to the franchise fee from five (5) percent to ten (10) percent, effective June 1, 2021, to sustain current levels of Solid Waste Division operations and programs and provide resources required for imminent state mandate compliance, including SB 1383. c) Approve the addition of a temporary special fee to the monthly residential rate to cover initial organics collection program fees for a period not to exceed 12 months. d) Approve a five-year schedule of fee adjustments to solid waste rates in accordance with the methodology specified in the Franchise Agreement, allowing for annual consideration of Consumer Price Index (CPI) changes on July 1 of each year; 2) Set the date of the public hearing to hear protests of the organics collection rate, franchise fee adjustments, temporary special fee, and five-year schedule of CPI adjustments as May 12, 2021 as soon after 6 p.m. as may practicably be heard; and 3) Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute the proposed third amendment to the franchise agreement with EDCO (to be finalized following the Proposition 218 public hearing) (Attachment 7 of the agenda report).
2021-03-10 Item 08F Authorization to Conduct a Proposition 218 Hearing
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Resolution authorizing the City of Encinitas (“City”) to become an Additional Member of the California Community Housing Agency (“CalCHA”); supporting CalCHA’s issuance of tax-exempt bonds for the production, preservation, and protection of essential middle-income (low, middle, and moderate) rental housing; and authorizing the City Manager to enter into Public Benefit Agreements with CalCHA for middle-income rental housing created within the City limits. Contact Person: Principal Planner Gates
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-15 approving the City to become an Additional Member of the California Community Housing Agency; 2) Authorize CalCHA’s issuance of tax-exempt bonds for the production, preservation, and protection of essential middle-income rental housing; and 3) Authorize the City Manager to execute Public Benefit Agreements with CalCHA for essential middle-income rental housing created within incorporated City limits. Any surplus cash generated from any transaction under the Public Benefit Agreements to the benefit of the City be placed in the City’s Affordable Housing Fund.
2021-03-10 Item 10A Authorizing the City to Join CalCHA
2021-03-10 Item 10A Authorizing the City to Join CalCHA - Presentation

12.

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON MARCH 17, 2021
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
